description: Dear Candidate, you have been selected for TCS Fresher Trainee role. Pay ₹1,500 refundable security deposit to confirm your interview gate pass. Transfer via UPI to hr-tcs@paytm.
Urgent hiring for Amazon Back Office Data Entry! 10th/12th pass can earn ₹2,500 per day. No interview needed. Work 2 hours daily from mobile. Contact HR on WhatsApp only: 9876543210.
Daily YouTube and Instagram like task job. Complete 10 tasks to earn ₹3,000 commission. Daily payout in USDT or bank transfer. Top-up wallet with ₹500 to unlock VIP merchant tasks.
Infosys campus drive 2026. Submit your Aadhaar card copy, PAN card, and bank account details with cancelled cheque before the telephonic interview round.
Direct joining in Wipro Technologies without interview! Immediate spot joining. Mandatory training kit charges ₹2,999 payable via GPay before receiving offer letter.
Google India work from home customer support. Guaranteed income ₹75,000 per month for freshers. Registration fee ₹950 for laptop courier and verification.
Canada work permit visa job offer. 100% guaranteed visa placement for fresh graduates. Visa processing fee ₹45,000 to be paid to authorized visa agent via PhonePe.
Leading MNC is hiring for confidential client. High earnings. Refer 5 friends to earn 20% passive income referral bonus. Build your team and achieve financial freedom.
Simple copy paste form filling work from home. Earn ₹15,000 to ₹25,000 weekly guaranteed payout. No experience or skill needed. Send resume to quickjobs@gmail.com.
Flipkart Delivery Executive and Office Boy openings. Selected without interview. Deposit ₹850 for uniform, ID card, and safety kit before reporting to warehouse.
Tata Consultancy Services direct hiring drive. Send CV on WhatsApp only: https://wa.me/919988776655. Offer letter within 24 hours of form submission.
Google Operations Center fresher recruitment. Review Google Maps and hotel listings to earn ₹500 per review. Daily cash payment credited to UPI.
Accenture paid training cum placement program. Pay ₹12,000 training fee with 100% guaranteed job placement upon course completion or money back.
Deloitte Analyst opening for 2025/2026 batch. Selected candidate must submit selfie with ID card and transfer ₹2,000 processing fee to confirm slot.
Microsoft India support engineer. Apply immediately! Limited seats remaining! URGENT OPENING!!! Contact hr-recruitment@outlook.com for appointment letter.

About the Company: Tata Consultancy Services is a global leader in IT services. Key Responsibilities: Develop, test, and maintain code modules under technical mentorship. Qualifications: B.E/B.Tech/MCA graduates with minimum 60% throughout academics. Realistic CTC: 3.36 LPA - 3.6 LPA.

Company Overview: Infosys is a digital transformation leader. Responsibilities: Participate in foundational training at Mysore campus; design scalable software solutions. Requirements: Bachelor of Engineering or Technology in CS/IT/ECE. CTC: 3.6 LPA to 4.0 LPA.

About Us: Amazon strives to be Earth's most customer-centric company. Responsibilities: Collaborate with senior engineers to deliver scalable distributed microservices. Requirements: Programming proficiency in Java, C++, or Python with strong understanding of data structures. Full-time position in Bangalore.

About Deloitte: Join a global leader in audit, consulting, and advisory services. Responsibilities: Analyze business data, develop test scripts, and support enterprise deployments. Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related quantitative discipline. Equal opportunity employer.

About the Team: Swiggy's analytics team powers food and grocery logistics. What you'll do: Build dashboards, write SQL queries, and evaluate experiment metrics. Who you are: Strong problem-solving aptitude, SQL knowledge, and analytical rigor. Compensation: 6 - 9 LPA depending on interview performance.

About the job: Google software engineers develop next-generation technologies. Responsibilities: Write clean, well-tested code in C++, Java, or Go. Qualifications: BS degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience with software engineering fundamentals. Hyderabad/Bangalore.

About Zomato: We are transforming food tech and rapid commerce. Key Deliverables: Design and maintain responsive frontend web components using TypeScript and React. Qualifications: Strong fundamentals in web standards, HTML/CSS, and modern JavaScript. Office location: Gurgaon.

About the Company: Wipro Limited is a leading technology services and consulting company. Responsibilities: Work within agile project teams delivering enterprise cloud applications. Eligibility: Full-time graduation in B.Tech/BE with 60% or 6.0 CGPA throughout 10th, 12th, and UG. Package: 3.5 LPA.

About Company: L&T Technology Services provides engineering R&D solutions. Responsibilities: Perform design calculations, 3D modeling, and testing verification. Requirements: BE Mechanical or Electrical with good academic standing. Selection involves written test followed by technical interview.

About the Organization: An early-stage fintech startup funded by top institutional VCs. Selected intern's day-to-day responsibilities: Developing backend REST APIs using Node.js and PostgreSQL. Skill(s) required: Node.js, Git, SQL. Fixed stipend: ₹20,000 - ₹30,000 /month.

About Us: Thoughtworks is a global software consultancy. What you will do: Practice test-driven development, pair programming, and continuous delivery. Requirements: Passion for coding, problem solving, and learning modern languages. No registration or interview fees are ever charged.

About Flipkart: India's homegrown e-commerce marketplace. Key Responsibilities: Design and develop core fulfillment and payment service modules. Qualifications: B.Tech/M.Tech in Computer Science; strong foundation in algorithms and system design. Bangalore.

Company Profile: Microsoft IDC. Role: Software Engineer - University Graduate. Responsibilities: Build cloud native services on Microsoft Azure. Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in CS or related field graduating in 2025/2026. Standard interview process with online assessment and technical interviews.

About Zoho: A bootstrapped software company making enterprise web applications. What we look for: Passion for programming, problem-solving skills, and fundamental understanding of computers. We do not look for degrees or marks; our recruitment process involves written aptitude and hands-on coding rounds.

Company Overview: Tech Mahindra represents the connected world. Job Responsibilities: Software development, debugging, and client technical support under senior lead guidance. Eligibility Criteria: 2025/2026 passed out BE/B.Tech/MCA candidates with minimum 60% aggregate. Salary: 3.25 LPA - 3.75 LPA.
